name: RearmCliInstall
description: Downloads and installs the Rearm CLI tool
author: Reliza Incorporated

inputs.name: rearmCliVersion
inputs.label: Rearm CLI Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of the Rearm CLI to install (e.g., '26.05.20'). The default version is verified against a SHA256 digest hardcoded into this task. First-class PullRequest support (--pr-* flags) requires 26.05.20 or later. To install a different version you MUST also provide its SHA256 digest via 'rearmCliSha256'; otherwise the task falls back to the default pinned version.

inputs.name: rearmCliSha256
inputs.label: Rearm CLI SHA256 Digest
inputs.helpMarkDown: SHA256 digest of the Rearm CLI archive for your agent's platform/architecture (the hex value from sha256sums.txt, e.g. for 'rearm-<version>-linux-amd64.zip'). Required only when overriding 'rearmCliVersion' to a non-default version. Leave empty to use the default pinned version, which is verified against a built-in digest.

outputVariables.name: RearmCli
outputVariables.description: Path to the Rearm CLI executable
